{{recipe}}

This puts a East Asian spin on classic barbecue ribs.

== Ingredients ==
* 1 slab [[Cookbook:Pork|pork]] spareribs
* [[Cookbook:Grill Seasoning|Grill Seasoning for Chops]], as needed
* ⅓ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Soy Sauce|soy sauce]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Mirin|mirin]]
* ¼ cup [[Cookbook:Honey|honey]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] rice [[Cookbook:Wine vinegar|wine vinegar]]
* 2 tbsp orange [[Cookbook:Marmalade|marmalade]]

== Procedure ==
#Shake the grill seasoning on ribs and gently massage into meat. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
#Combine remaining ingredients. Refrigerate until needed.
#Place ribs into a large [[Cookbook:Aluminium Foil|foil]] pouch. Pour in soy mixture and tilt to evenly distribute. Tightly crimp the edges to seal.
#[[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] at 250°F for 5 hours.
#Snip foil pouch over a large saucepan to release liquid. Degrease and bring liquid to a boil over high heat for 5 minutes.
#[[Cookbook:Brush|Brush]] generously on one side of ribs and either [[Cookbook:Grilling|grill]] glaze side down over high heat or place glaze side up under a preheated [[Cookbook:Broiler|broiler]] until nicely browned.
#Slice into 1-rib portions and [[Cookbook:Mixing#Tossing|toss]] with some of the remaining soy mixture. Serve.
